test_title: SSC CPO 2023 Official Paper-I (Held On: 05 Oct, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: What is the bicameral legislature of the Indian Constitution?

options.text: It is legislative body with three houses.
It is legislative body with two houses.
It is legislative body with one house.
It is legislative body with four houses.

solution:
The correct answer is __**It is legislative body with two houses**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **bicameral legislature of the Indian Constitution Consists of two houses**.
 
• The** two houses **are the **Rajya Sabha** (Council of States) and the **Lok Sabha** (House of the People).
 
• **Each house** has its **powers and functions**.
 
• **Both houses play a crucial role **in the** legislative process and governance of the country**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Lok Sabha**

 
 
• **It represents the people of India**.
 
• Members of the **Lok Sabha are directly elected** by the** eligible voters in general elections**.
 
• **Lok Sabha members** serve a term of **five years** unless dissolved earlier.
 
 
 
• **Rajya Sabha**
 
 
• **It represents the states and union territories of India.**
 
• **Members are not directly elected **by the people but are** elected by the elected members of the State Legislative Assemblies**.
 
• **Rajya Sabha members** serve staggered terms, with **one-third of its members retiring every two years**.
